result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by giving Licensee a 30-day termination-for-convenience right and requiring a refund of prepaid fees allocable to the post-termination period, while granting Licensor no corresponding right during the committed term. However, permitting termination “in whole or in part” is unnecessary, and the statement that Licensee owes no payment “in respect of any period after” termination is broader than needed and could unintentionally eliminate surviving, usage-based, transition, indemnity, or other post-termination payment obligations. The refund should instead be stated expressly as a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees for terminated services after the effective date.
